1import Determinize.Proof.Symbolic.Mean
2import Mathlib.Probability.Kernel.Composition.IntegralCompProd

5/-!
6# Soundness of symbolic reduction
7
8The symbolic semantics preserves typing and operation-domain safety while
9replacing E samples by their means. Operational trace soundness builds on these
10invariants in `CompactFiberSoundness`.
11-/

22theorem convex_integral_mem_real {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
23 {μ : Measure α} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {set : Set ℝ} {value : α → ℝ}
24 (hConvex : Convex ℝ set) (hMem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, value x ∈ set)
25 (hIntegrable : Integrable value μ) : (∫ x, value x ∂μ) ∈ set := by
26 let mean := ∫ x, value x ∂μ
27 change mean ∈ set
28 by_contra hMean
29 have hNonempty : set.Nonempty := by
30 rcases hMem.exists with ⟨x, hx⟩
31 exact ⟨value x, hx⟩
32 rcases hNonempty with ⟨point, hPoint⟩
33 have hPointNe : point ≠ mean := fun equality => hMean (equality ▸ hPoint)
34 have hConstant : Integrable (fun _ : α => mean) μ := integrable_const mean
35 have hConstantIntegral : (∫ _ : α, mean ∂μ) = mean := by simp
36 rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hPointNe with hBelow | hAbove
37 · have hAllBelow : ∀ y ∈ set, y < mean := by
38 intro y hy
39 by_contra hNotBelow
40 exact hMean (hConvex.ordConnected.out hPoint hy
41 ⟨hBelow.le, le_of_not_gt hNotBelow⟩)
42 have hStrict : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, value x < mean :=
43 hMem.mono fun x hx => hAllBelow (value x) hx
44 have hEq : value =ᵐ[μ] fun _ => mean :=
45 (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le hIntegrable hConstant
46 (hStrict.mono fun _ hx => hx.le)).mp (by rw [hConstantIntegral])
47 exact (hEq.and hStrict).exists.elim fun _ hx => (hx.2.ne hx.1).elim
48 · have hAllAbove : ∀ y ∈ set, mean < y := by
49 intro y hy
50 by_contra hNotAbove
51 exact hMean (hConvex.ordConnected.out hy hPoint
52 ⟨le_of_not_gt hNotAbove, hAbove.le⟩)
53 have hStrict : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, mean < value x :=
54 hMem.mono fun x hx => hAllAbove (value x) hx
55 have hEq : (fun _ : α => mean) =ᵐ[μ] value :=
56 (integral_eq_iff_of_ae_le hConstant hIntegrable
57 (hStrict.mono fun _ hx => hx.le)).mp (by rw [hConstantIntegral])
58 exact (hEq.and hStrict).exists.elim fun _ hx => (hx.2.ne hx.1).elim

64noncomputable def substituteHeadMean (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1)) (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
65 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
66 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ) : Symbolic.Affine n :=
67 add (tail expression) (smul (expression.2 0) (primitiveMean op affineArgs generalArgs))
68
69theorem eval_cons (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1)) (value : ℝ)
70 (environment : Env n) :
71 Symbolic.Affine.eval expression (Env.cons value environment) =
72 Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment + expression.2 0 * value := by
73 simp only [Symbolic.Affine.eval, tail, Fin.tail, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Env.cons_zero,
74 Env.cons_succ]
75 ring
76
77theorem eval_cons_convexCombination (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1))
78 (environment : Env n) (left right a b : ℝ) (hSum : a + b = 1) :
79 Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment +
80 expression.2 0 * (a * left + b * right) =
81 a * (Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment + expression.2 0 * left) +
82 b * (Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment + expression.2 0 * right) := by
83 linear_combination -(Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment) * hSum
84
85theorem eval_substituteHeadMean (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1)) (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
86 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
87 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ)
88 (environment : Env n) :
89 Symbolic.Affine.eval (substituteHeadMean expression op affineArgs generalArgs) environment =
90 Symbolic.Affine.eval (tail expression) environment + expression.2 0 *
91 Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op
92 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs) := by
93 rw [substituteHeadMean, Symbolic.Affine.eval_add, Symbolic.Affine.eval_smul, eval_primitiveMean]
94

97theorem domain_valueSet_convex (queryOp : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
98 (queryAffineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity queryOp) → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1))
99 (queryGeneralArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity queryOp) → ℝ)
100 (environment : Env n) :
101 Convex ℝ {value : ℝ | Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain queryOp
102 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (queryAffineArgs i) (Env.cons value environment),
103 queryGeneralArgs)} := by
104 rw [convex_iff_add_mem]
105 intro left leftDomain right rightDomain a b ha hb hab
106 cases queryOp with
107 | uniform =>
108 change Fin 2 → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1) at queryAffineArgs
109 change Fin 0 → ℝ at queryGeneralArgs
110 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
111 simp only [Affine.eval_cons, smul_eq_mul] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
112 simp_rw [Affine.eval_cons_convexCombination _ environment left right a b hab]
113 exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left leftDomain ha)
114 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left rightDomain hb)
115 | gaussian => exact leftDomain
116 | poisson =>
117 change Fin 1 → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1) at queryAffineArgs
118 change Fin 0 → ℝ at queryGeneralArgs
119 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
120 simp only [Affine.eval_cons, smul_eq_mul] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
121 rw [Affine.eval_cons_convexCombination _ environment left right a b hab]
122 exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha leftDomain) (mul_nonneg hb rightDomain)
123 | exponential => exact leftDomain
124 | beta => exact leftDomain
125 | gamma =>
126 change Fin 1 → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1) at queryAffineArgs
127 change Fin 1 → ℝ at queryGeneralArgs
128 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
129 constructor
130 · simp only [Affine.eval_cons, smul_eq_mul] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
131 rw [Affine.eval_cons_convexCombination _ environment left right a b hab]
132 rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | haPos
133 · have hbOne : b = 1 := by linarith
134 simpa [hbOne] using rightDomain.1
135 · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (mul_pos haPos leftDomain.1)
136 (mul_nonneg hb rightDomain.1.le)
137 · exact leftDomain.2
138
139 | bernoulli =>
140 change Fin 1 → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1) at queryAffineArgs
141 change Fin 0 → ℝ at queryGeneralArgs
142 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
143 simp only [Affine.eval_cons, smul_eq_mul] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
144 rw [Affine.eval_cons_convexCombination _ environment left right a b hab]
145 constructor
146 · exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha leftDomain.1) (mul_nonneg hb rightDomain.1)
147 · have bound := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left leftDomain.2 ha)
148 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left rightDomain.2 hb)
149 simpa [hab] using bound
150 | discrete arity =>
151 change Fin arity → Symbolic.Affine (n + 1) at queryAffineArgs
152 change Fin 0 → ℝ at queryGeneralArgs
153 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
154 simp only [Affine.eval_cons, smul_eq_mul] at leftDomain rightDomain ⊢
155 simp_rw [Affine.eval_cons_convexCombination _ environment left right a b hab]
156 refine ⟨fun i => add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha (leftDomain.1 i))
157 (mul_nonneg hb (rightDomain.1 i)), ?_⟩
158 rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
159 have bound := add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left leftDomain.2 ha)
160 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left rightDomain.2 hb)
161 simpa [hab] using bound

163noncomputable def transitionPack (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
164 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
165 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
166 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ) :
167 SFiniteKernel (Env n) (Env (n + 1)) :=
168 SFiniteKernel.mapWithInput
169 (SFiniteKernel.pullback (primitiveKernelPack laws (.sample .E) op)
170 (fun environment : Env n =>
171 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs))
172 ((measurable_pi_lambda _ fun i =>
173 Determinize.Proof.Paper.Symbolic.AffineExpr.affine_eval_measurable (affineArgs i)).prodMk
174 measurable_const))
175 (fun input => Env.cons input.2 input.1)
176 (measurable_envCons.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))
177
178theorem transitionPack_apply (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
179 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
180 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ)
181 (environment : Env n) :
182 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel environment =
183 (laws.kernel op
184 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)).map
185 (fun value => Env.cons value environment) := by
186 rw [transitionPack, SFiniteKernel.mapWithInput_apply, MeasurableActionFamily.pullback_apply]
187 rfl

189theorem actualMeasure_univ_eq_one (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
190 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n)
191 (safe : Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws history) :
192 Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history Set.univ = 1 := by
193 induction history with
194 | nil => simp [Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure]
195 | snoc history op affineArgs generalArgs ih =>
196 rw [Determinize.Proof.Paper.Symbolic.AffineExpr.actualMeasure_snoc]
197 have transitionEq :
198 (fun environment =>
199 (laws.kernel op
200 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)).map
201 (fun value => Env.cons value environment)) =
202 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel := by
203 funext environment
204 exact (transitionPack_apply laws op affineArgs generalArgs environment).symm
205 rw [transitionEq]
206 rw [Measure.bind_apply MeasurableSet.univ
207 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel.aemeasurable]
208 have fiberOne : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
209 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel environment Set.univ = 1 := by
210 filter_upwards [safe.2] with environment domain
211 rw [transitionPack_apply]
212 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable (fun value : ℝ =>
213 Env.cons value environment) :=
214 measurable_envCons.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
215 rw [Measure.map_apply sectionMeasurable MeasurableSet.univ]
216 simpa only [Set.preimage_univ] using laws.mass_one op _ domain
217 calc
218 (∫⁻ environment,
219 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel environment Set.univ
220 ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history) =
221 ∫⁻ _environment, 1 ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history :=
222 lintegral_congr_ae fiberOne
223 _ = Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history Set.univ := lintegral_one
224 _ = 1 := ih safe.1

226theorem actualMeasure_snoc_eq_comp (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
227 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n) (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
228 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
229 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ) :
230 Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws
231 (.snoc history op affineArgs generalArgs) =
232 (transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel ∘ₘ
233 Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history := by
234 rw [Determinize.Proof.Paper.Symbolic.AffineExpr.actualMeasure_snoc]
235 apply Measure.bind_congr_right
236 filter_upwards [] with environment
237 exact (transitionPack_apply laws op affineArgs generalArgs environment).symm

239theorem integrable_eval_transition (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
240 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
241 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
242 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ)
243 (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1)) (environment : Env n)
244 (domain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
245 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)) :
246 Integrable (fun nextEnvironment => Symbolic.Affine.eval expression nextEnvironment)
247 ((transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel environment) := by
248 rw [transitionPack_apply]
249 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable (fun value : ℝ => Env.cons value environment) :=
250 measurable_envCons.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
251 rw [integrable_map_measure
252 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.Symbolic.AffineExpr.affine_eval_measurable
253 expression).aestronglyMeasurable sectionMeasurable.aemeasurable]
254 let params : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op :=
255 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)
256 have mass : laws.kernel op params Set.univ = 1 := laws.mass_one op params domain
257 let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (laws.kernel op params) := ⟨by rw [mass]; simp⟩
258 change Integrable (Symbolic.Affine.eval expression ∘
259 fun value => Env.cons value environment) (laws.kernel op params)
260 have affineIntegrable := (integrable_const
261 (Symbolic.Affine.eval (Symbolic.Affine.tail expression) environment)).add
262 ((laws.integrable_id op params domain).const_mul (expression.2 0))
263 have functionEq : (Symbolic.Affine.eval expression ∘
264 fun value => Env.cons value environment) =
265 (fun value => Symbolic.Affine.eval (Symbolic.Affine.tail expression) environment) +
266 fun value => expression.2 0 * value := by
267 funext value
268 exact Affine.eval_cons expression value environment
269 rw [functionEq]
270 exact affineIntegrable

272theorem integral_eval_transition (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op)
273 (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
274 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ)
275 (expression : Symbolic.Affine (n + 1)) (environment : Env n)
276 (domain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
277 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)) :
278 (∫ nextEnvironment, Symbolic.Affine.eval expression nextEnvironment
279 ∂(transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel environment) =
280 Symbolic.Affine.eval
281 (Affine.substituteHeadMean expression op affineArgs generalArgs) environment := by
282 rw [transitionPack_apply]
283 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable (fun value : ℝ => Env.cons value environment) :=
284 measurable_envCons.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
285 rw [integral_map sectionMeasurable.aemeasurable
286 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.Symbolic.AffineExpr.affine_eval_measurable
287 expression).aestronglyMeasurable]
288 simp_rw [Affine.eval_cons]
289 let params : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op :=
290 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)
291 have mass : laws.kernel op params Set.univ = 1 := laws.mass_one op params domain
292 let _ : IsFiniteMeasure (laws.kernel op params) := ⟨by rw [mass]; simp⟩
293 have identityIntegrable : Integrable (fun value : ℝ => value) (laws.kernel op params) :=
294 laws.integrable_id op params domain
295 have constantIntegrable : Integrable
296 (fun _value : ℝ => Symbolic.Affine.eval (Symbolic.Affine.tail expression) environment)
297 (laws.kernel op params) :=
298 integrable_const_iff.mpr (Or.inr inferInstance)
299 have scaledIntegrable : Integrable
300 (fun value : ℝ => expression.2 0 * value) (laws.kernel op params) :=
301 identityIntegrable.const_mul _
302 rw [integral_add constantIntegrable scaledIntegrable]
303 rw [integral_const, integral_const_mul]
304 rw [laws.mean_law op params domain]
305 rw [Affine.eval_substituteHeadMean]
306 simp only [Measure.real, mass, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul]
307 rfl

309theorem domain_at_meanEnvironment (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
310 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n)
311 (safe : Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws history)
312 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op) (affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n)
313 (generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ)
314 (domainAE : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
315 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
316 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) environment, generalArgs)) :
317 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
318 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i)
319 (Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment laws history), generalArgs) := by
320 induction history generalizing op with
321 | nil =>
322 simpa [Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure, Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment,
323 ] using domainAE
324 | @snoc n history sampledOp sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs ih =>
325 let prior := Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history
326 let transition :=
327 (transitionPack laws sampledOp sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs).kernel
328 have actualEq : Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws
329 (.snoc history sampledOp sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs) = transition ∘ₘ prior :=
330 actualMeasure_snoc_eq_comp laws history sampledOp sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs
331 have fiberDomain : ∀ᵐ environment ∂prior,
332 ∀ᵐ nextEnvironment ∂transition environment,
333 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
334 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i) nextEnvironment, generalArgs) := by
335 rw [actualEq] at domainAE
336 exact Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_bind transition.aemeasurable domainAE
337 let reducedArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n := fun i =>
338 Affine.substituteHeadMean (affineArgs i) sampledOp
339 sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs
340 have reducedDomainAE : ∀ᵐ environment ∂prior,
341 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
342 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (reducedArgs i) environment, generalArgs) := by
343 filter_upwards [safe.2, fiberDomain] with environment sampledDomain queryDomain
344 let sampledParams : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params sampledOp :=
345 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (sampledAffineArgs i) environment,
346 sampledGeneralArgs)
347 have transitionApply : transition environment =
348 (laws.kernel sampledOp sampledParams).map
349 (fun value => Env.cons value environment) := by
350 exact transitionPack_apply laws sampledOp sampledAffineArgs sampledGeneralArgs environment
351 rw [transitionApply] at queryDomain
352 have sectionMeasurable : Measurable (fun value : ℝ => Env.cons value environment) :=
353 measurable_envCons.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
354 have drawDomain : ∀ᵐ value ∂laws.kernel sampledOp sampledParams,
355 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
356 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i)
357 (Env.cons value environment), generalArgs) :=
358 MeasureTheory.ae_of_ae_map sectionMeasurable.aemeasurable queryDomain
359 let _ : IsProbabilityMeasure (laws.kernel sampledOp sampledParams) :=
360 ⟨laws.mass_one sampledOp sampledParams sampledDomain⟩
361 have meanDomain := convex_integral_mem_real
362 (domain_valueSet_convex op affineArgs generalArgs environment) drawDomain
363 (laws.integrable_id sampledOp sampledParams sampledDomain)
364 rw [laws.mean_law sampledOp sampledParams sampledDomain] at meanDomain
365 change Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
366 (fun i => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs i)
367 (Env.cons (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue sampledOp sampledParams) environment), generalArgs)
368 at meanDomain
369 simpa only [reducedArgs, Affine.eval_substituteHeadMean, ← Affine.eval_cons]
370 using meanDomain
371 have reducedAtMean := ih safe.1 op reducedArgs generalArgs reducedDomainAE
372 rw [Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment]
373 simpa only [reducedArgs, Affine.eval_substituteHeadMean, ← Affine.eval_cons]
374 using reducedAtMean
375
376end SampleEnv

382def SafeConfigAt (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) (fuel : Nat)
383 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n) (expression : Symbolic.AffineExpr n) : Prop :=
384 Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws history ∧
385 Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] expression (.float .E) ∧
386 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
387 DomainSafeAt fuel (expression.realize environment)

389theorem stochastic_mass_one_imp_domain (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws)
390 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op) (params : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op)
391 (mass : laws.kernel op params Set.univ = 1) : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op params := by
392 by_contra outside
393 rw [laws.kernel_zero_off_domain op params outside] at mass
394 simp at mass

396theorem nStepMeasure_mass_le_one (stepKernel : StepKernel)
397 (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
398 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression Set.univ ≤ 1 := by
399 induction fuel generalizing expression with
400 | zero => simp [nStepMeasure]
401 | succ fuel ih =>
402 rw [nStepMeasure, Measure.bind_apply MeasurableSet.univ
403 stepKernel.kernel.aemeasurable]
404 calc
405 (∫⁻ current, stepKernel.kernel current Set.univ
406 ∂nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression) ≤
407 ∫⁻ _current, 1 ∂nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression :=
408 lintegral_mono fun current => stepKernel.mass_le_one current
409 _ = nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression Set.univ := lintegral_one
410 _ ≤ 1 := ih expression

412theorem ae_eq_one_of_lintegral_eq_one {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
413 (μ : Measure α) (mass : μ Set.univ = 1)
414 (f : α → ENNReal) (measurableF : Measurable f)
415 (bounded : ∀ x, f x ≤ 1) (integral : (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) = 1) :
416 ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, f x = 1 := by
417 have finite : (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) ≠ ⊤ := by simp [integral]
418 have subIntegral : (∫⁻ x, 1 - f x ∂μ) = 0 := by
419 rw [lintegral_sub measurableF finite (Filter.Eventually.of_forall bounded)]
420 simp [mass, integral]
421 have subZero := (lintegral_eq_zero_iff'
422 (measurable_const.sub measurableF).aemeasurable).mp subIntegral
423 filter_upwards [subZero] with x hx
424 exact le_antisymm (bounded x) (tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp hx)

426theorem nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one_of_value (stepKernel : StepKernel)
427 (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr) (value : expression.isValue = true) :
428 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression Set.univ = 1 := by
429 have measureEq : ∀ fuel,
430 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression = Measure.dirac expression := by
431 intro depth
432 induction depth with
433 | zero => rfl
434 | succ depth ih =>
435 rw [nStepMeasure, ih, Measure.dirac_bind stepKernel.kernel.measurable,
436 Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.stepKernel_eq_dirac_of_value
437 stepKernel expression value]
438 rw [measureEq fuel]
439 simp

442 (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
443 nStepMeasure stepKernel (fuel + 1) expression =
444 (stepKernel.kernel expression).bind (nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel) := by

446 stepKernel (fuel + 1) expression]
447 rw [Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack_succ_kernel]
448 rw [Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernel_commutes]
449 rw [Kernel.comp_apply]
450 congr 1
451 funext successor
452 exact Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack_apply
453 stepKernel fuel successor

455theorem nStepMeasure_succ_sample_univ
456 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr)
457 (fiber : Measure ℝ) (continuation : ℝ → Expr)
458 (reduction : reduce expression = .sample site fiber continuation) :
459 nStepMeasure stepKernel (fuel + 1) expression Set.univ =
460 ∫⁻ value, nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ ∂fiber := by
461 rw [nStepMeasure_succ_eq_firstStep stepKernel fuel expression,
462 show nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel =
463 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack
464 stepKernel fuel).kernel from by
465 funext successor
466 exact (Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack_apply
467 stepKernel fuel successor).symm,
468 Measure.bind_apply MeasurableSet.univ
469 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack
470 stepKernel fuel).kernel.aemeasurable]
471 rw [stepKernel.kernel_eq_stepMeasure]
472 unfold stepMeasure
473 rw [reduction]
474 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.Action.measure]
475 have continuationMeasurable := stepKernel.sample_continuation_measurable
476 expression fiber continuation reduction
477 rw [MeasureTheory.lintegral_map'
478 ((Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack
479 stepKernel fuel).kernel.measurable_coe MeasurableSet.univ).aemeasurable
480 continuationMeasurable.aemeasurable]

483 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) (expression next : Expr)
484 (reduction : reduce expression = .next next) :
485 nStepMeasure stepKernel (fuel + 1) expression Set.univ =
486 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel next Set.univ := by

493 stepKernel fuel).kernel from by

501theorem domainSafeAt_iff_nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one
502 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat) (expression : Expr)
503 (typed : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Typed [] expression ty) :
504 Determinize.Spec.Paper.DomainSafeAt fuel expression ↔
505 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel expression Set.univ = 1 := by
506 induction fuel generalizing expression ty with
507 | zero => simp [DomainSafeAt, nStepMeasure]
508 | succ fuel ih =>
509 by_cases value : expression.isValue = true
510 · simp only [DomainSafeAt, value, ↓reduceIte]
511 exact (iff_true_intro
512 (nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one_of_value stepKernel (fuel + 1) expression value)).symm
513 · have valueFalse : expression.isValue = false := Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true value
514 simp only [DomainSafeAt, valueFalse, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
515 have actionTyped := Typing.reduce_typed_closed typed
516 cases reduction : reduce expression with
517 | next next =>
518 simp only
519 rw [reduction] at actionTyped
520 cases actionTyped with
521 | next nextTyped =>
522 rw [nStepMeasure_succ_next_univ stepKernel fuel expression next reduction]
523 exact ih next nextTyped
524 | sample site fiber continuation =>
525 simp only
526 rw [reduction] at actionTyped
527 cases actionTyped with
528 | sample continuationTyped =>
529 rw [nStepMeasure_succ_sample_univ stepKernel fuel expression fiber continuation
530 reduction]
531 constructor
532 · rintro ⟨fiberMass, continuationSafe⟩
533 calc
534 (∫⁻ value, nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ
535 ∂fiber) = ∫⁻ _value, 1 ∂fiber :=
536 lintegral_congr_ae (continuationSafe.mono fun value safe =>
537 (ih (continuation value) (continuationTyped value)).mp safe)
538 _ = fiber Set.univ := lintegral_one
539 _ = 1 := fiberMass
540 · intro totalMass
541 have integralLeFiber :
542 (∫⁻ value, nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ
543 ∂fiber) ≤ fiber Set.univ := by
544 calc
545 (∫⁻ value, nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ
546 ∂fiber) ≤ ∫⁻ _value, 1 ∂fiber :=
547 lintegral_mono fun value =>
548 nStepMeasure_mass_le_one stepKernel fuel (continuation value)
549 _ = fiber Set.univ := lintegral_one
550 have fiberLeOne : fiber Set.univ ≤ 1 := by
551 have kernelLeOne := stepKernel.mass_le_one expression
552 rw [stepKernel.kernel_eq_stepMeasure] at kernelLeOne
553 unfold stepMeasure at kernelLeOne
554 rw [reduction] at kernelLeOne
555 simp only [Determinize.Spec.Paper.Action.measure] at kernelLeOne
556 rw [Measure.map_apply
557 (stepKernel.sample_continuation_measurable expression fiber continuation
558 reduction) MeasurableSet.univ] at kernelLeOne
559 simpa using kernelLeOne
560 have fiberMass : fiber Set.univ = 1 :=
561 le_antisymm fiberLeOne (totalMass ▸ integralLeFiber)
562 have continuationMeasurable :=
563 stepKernel.sample_continuation_measurable expression fiber continuation reduction
564 have massMeasurable : Measurable fun value =>
565 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ := by
566 have kernelMeasurable :=
567 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack
568 stepKernel fuel).kernel.measurable_coe MeasurableSet.univ
569 have composed := kernelMeasurable.comp continuationMeasurable
570 change Measurable ((fun successor =>
571 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel successor Set.univ) ∘ continuation)
572 simpa only [Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack_apply]
573 using composed
574 refine ⟨fiberMass, ?_⟩
575 have continuationMass := ae_eq_one_of_lintegral_eq_one fiber fiberMass
576 (fun value => nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel (continuation value) Set.univ)
577 massMeasurable
578 (fun value => nStepMeasure_mass_le_one stepKernel fuel (continuation value))
579 totalMass
580 filter_upwards [continuationMass] with value mass
581 exact (ih (continuation value) (continuationTyped value)).mpr mass
582 | stuck =>
583 rw [nStepMeasure_succ_eq_firstStep stepKernel fuel expression,
584 stepKernel.kernel_eq_stepMeasure]
585 simp [stepMeasure, reduction, Determinize.Spec.Paper.Action.measure]

595 change Measurable ((fun successor =>
596 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel successor Set.univ) ∘ expression.realize)

600theorem measurableSet_domainSafeAt_realize
601 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat)
602 (expression : Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
603 (typed : Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] expression ty) :
604 MeasurableSet {environment |

607 DomainSafeAt fuel (expression.realize environment)} =

609 (expression.realize environment) Set.univ) ⁻¹' {1} := by
610 ext environment
611 exact domainSafeAt_iff_nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one stepKernel fuel

616theorem exists_jointContinuation {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
617 {action : α → Action}
618 (family : MeasurableActionFamily α action) :
619 ∃ joint : α × ℝ → Expr, Measurable joint ∧
620 ∀ parameter fiber continuation,
621 action parameter = .sample site fiber continuation →
622 ∀ value, joint (parameter, value) = continuation value := by
623 induction family with
624 | @next successor successorMeasurable =>
625 exact ⟨fun _ => .unit, measurable_const, by
626 intro parameter fiber continuation equality
627 cases equality⟩
628 | @sample actualSite draw continuation continuationMeasurable =>
629 exact ⟨continuation, continuationMeasurable, by
630 intro parameter fiber next equality value
631 simp only [Action.sample.injEq] at equality
632 exact congrFun equality.2.2 value⟩
633 | stuck =>
634 exact ⟨fun _ => .unit, measurable_const, by
635 intro parameter fiber continuation equality
636 cases equality⟩
637 | @piecewise region _ measurableRegion whenTrue whenFalse trueFamily falseFamily
638 trueResult falseResult =>
639 rcases trueResult with ⟨trueContinuation, trueMeasurable, trueRule⟩
640 rcases falseResult with ⟨falseContinuation, falseMeasurable, falseRule⟩
641 classical
642 let pairRegion : Set (α × ℝ) := {pair | pair.1 ∈ region}
643 refine ⟨pairRegion.piecewise trueContinuation falseContinuation, ?_, ?_⟩
644 · exact Measurable.piecewise (measurableRegion.preimage measurable_fst)
645 trueMeasurable falseMeasurable
646 · intro parameter fiber continuation equality value
647 by_cases member : parameter ∈ region
648 · simp only [Set.piecewise, member, ↓reduceIte] at equality
649 change (if parameter ∈ region then trueContinuation (parameter, value)
650 else falseContinuation (parameter, value)) = continuation value
651 rw [if_pos member]
652 exact trueRule parameter fiber continuation equality value
653 · simp only [Set.piecewise, member, ↓reduceIte] at equality
654 change (if parameter ∈ region then trueContinuation (parameter, value)
655 else falseContinuation (parameter, value)) = continuation value
656 rw [if_neg member]
657 exact falseRule parameter fiber continuation equality value
658
659theorem sampleG_joint_nStepMass_measurable (laws : PrimitiveLaws)
660 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat)
661 (expression : Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
662 (typed : Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] expression ty)
663 (fiber : Measure ℝ)
664 (continuation : ℝ → Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
665 (reduction : Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce expression =
666 Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.sampleG site fiber continuation) :
667 Measurable fun pair : Env n × ℝ =>
668 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel ((continuation pair.2).realize pair.1) Set.univ := by
669 let family := Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.reduceFamily
670 laws expression.realizeFamily
671 rcases exists_jointContinuation family with ⟨joint, jointMeasurable, jointRule⟩
672 have jointEq : joint = fun pair : Env n × ℝ =>
673 (continuation pair.2).realize pair.1 := by
674 funext pair
675 exact jointRule pair.1 fiber
676 (fun value => (continuation value).realize pair.1) (by
677 rw [← Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_realize typed pair.1, reduction]
678 rfl) pair.2
679 change Measurable ((fun successor =>
680 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel successor Set.univ) ∘
681 fun pair : Env n × ℝ => (continuation pair.2).realize pair.1)
682 rw [← jointEq]
683 have massMeasurable :=
684 (Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack
685 stepKernel fuel).kernel.measurable_coe MeasurableSet.univ
686 have composed := massMeasurable.comp jointMeasurable
687 simpa only [Determinize.Proof.Paper.MeasurableActionFamily.nStepKernelPack_apply]
688 using composed

698theorem source_sampleG_safe_swap
699 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat)
700 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n)
701 (historySafe : Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws history)
702 (expression : Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
703 (typed : Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] expression ty)
704 (sourceSafe : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
705 DomainSafeAt (fuel + 1) (expression.realize environment))
706 (fiber : Measure ℝ) (continuation : ℝ → Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
707 (reduction : Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce expression =
708 Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.sampleG site fiber continuation) :
709 fiber Set.univ = 1 ∧
710 ∀ᵐ value ∂fiber,
711 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
712 DomainSafeAt fuel ((continuation value).realize environment) := by
713 have actionTyped := Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_wellTyped typed
714 rw [reduction] at actionTyped
715 have continuationTyped : ∀ value,
716 Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] (continuation value) ty := by
717 simpa only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wellTyped_sampleG_iff]
718 using actionTyped
719 have concreteReduction (environment : Env n) :
720 reduce (expression.realize environment) =
721 .sample site fiber (fun value => (continuation value).realize environment) := by
722 rw [← Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_realize typed environment,
723 reduction]
724 rfl
725 have sourceActionSafe :
726 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
727 fiber Set.univ = 1 ∧ ∀ᵐ value ∂fiber,
728 DomainSafeAt fuel ((continuation value).realize environment) := by
729 filter_upwards [sourceSafe] with environment safe
730 have notValue := not_value_of_reduce_sample (expression.realize environment)
731 fiber (fun value => (continuation value).realize environment) (concreteReduction environment)
732 simp only [DomainSafeAt, Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true notValue,
733 Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, concreteReduction] at safe
734 exact safe
735 have actualMass := SampleEnv.actualMeasure_univ_eq_one laws history historySafe
736 let : NeZero (Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history) := ⟨by
737 intro zero
738 rw [zero] at actualMass
739 simp at actualMass⟩
740 have fiberMass : fiber Set.univ = 1 := by
741 have massAE := sourceActionSafe.mono fun _ safe => safe.1
742 rcases massAE.exists with ⟨_, mass⟩
743 exact mass
744 refine ⟨fiberMass, ?_⟩
745 have nestedMass :
746 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
747 ∀ᵐ value ∂fiber,
748 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel ((continuation value).realize environment) Set.univ = 1 := by
749 filter_upwards [sourceActionSafe] with environment safe
750 filter_upwards [safe.2] with value continuationSafe
751 exact (domainSafeAt_iff_nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one stepKernel fuel
752 ((continuation value).realize environment)
753 ((continuationTyped value).realize_typed environment)).mp continuationSafe
754 have jointMeasurable := sampleG_joint_nStepMass_measurable laws stepKernel fuel expression
755 typed fiber continuation reduction
756 have massSetMeasurable : MeasurableSet
757 {pair : Env n × ℝ |
758 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel ((continuation pair.2).realize pair.1) Set.univ = 1} :=
759 jointMeasurable (measurableSet_singleton 1)
760 let : IsFiniteMeasure fiber := ⟨by rw [fiberMass]; simp⟩
761 let : IsFiniteMeasure (Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history) :=
762 ⟨by rw [actualMass]; simp⟩
763 have swappedMass : ∀ᵐ value ∂fiber,
764 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
765 nStepMeasure stepKernel fuel ((continuation value).realize environment) Set.univ = 1 :=
766 (Measure.ae_ae_comm massSetMeasurable).mp nestedMass
767 filter_upwards [swappedMass] with value safeAtValue
768 filter_upwards [safeAtValue] with environment mass
769 exact (domainSafeAt_iff_nStepMeasure_univ_eq_one stepKernel fuel
770 ((continuation value).realize environment)
771 ((continuationTyped value).realize_typed environment)).mpr mass

773theorem source_sampleE_safe_extension
774 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat)
775 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n)
776 (historySafe : Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws history)
777 (expression : Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
778 (typed : Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] expression ty)
779 (sourceSafe : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
780 DomainSafeAt (fuel + 1) (expression.realize environment))
781 (op : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Op) (affine : List (Symbolic.Affine n)) (general : List ℝ)
782 (continuation : Symbolic.AffineExpr (n + 1))
783 (reduction : Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce expression =
784 Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.sampleE op affine general continuation) :
785 let affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n :=
786 fun index => affine.getD index.1 (0, fun _ => 0)
787 let generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ :=
788 fun index => general.getD index.1 0
789 let extended := Symbolic.SampleEnv.snoc history op affineArgs generalArgs
790 Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws extended ∧
791 Symbolic.AffineExpr.WellTyped [] continuation ty ∧
792 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws extended,
793 DomainSafeAt fuel (continuation.realize environment) := by
794 have actionTyped := Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_wellTyped typed
795 rw [reduction] at actionTyped
796 rcases (Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wellTyped_sampleE_iff.mp actionTyped) with
797 ⟨affineLength, generalLength, continuationTyped⟩
798 let affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n :=
799 fun index => affine.getD index.1 (0, fun _ => 0)
800 let generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ :=
801 fun index => general.getD index.1 0
802 let extended := Symbolic.SampleEnv.snoc history op affineArgs generalArgs
803 have concreteReduction (environment : Env n) :
804 reduce (expression.realize environment) =
805 .sample (.sample .E, op) (laws.kernel op
806 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) environment, generalArgs))
807 (fun value => continuation.realize (Env.cons value environment)) := by
808 rw [← Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_realize typed environment,
809 reduction]
810 simp only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.realize]
811 congr 1
812 classical
813 unfold primitiveFiber
814 Determinize.Spec.Paper.parseParams
815 simp only
816 rw [dif_pos (by simpa using affineLength), dif_pos generalLength]
817 simp only
818 rw [laws.kernel_eq_paperMeasure]
819 congr 1
820 apply Prod.ext
821 · funext index
822 simp [affineArgs, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, affineLength]
823 · funext index
824 simp [generalArgs, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, generalLength]
825 have sourceActionSafe :
826 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
827 (laws.kernel op
828 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) environment, generalArgs))
829 Set.univ = 1 ∧
830 ∀ᵐ value ∂laws.kernel op
831 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) environment, generalArgs),
832 DomainSafeAt fuel
833 (continuation.realize (Env.cons value environment)) := by
834 filter_upwards [sourceSafe] with environment safe
835 have notValue := not_value_of_reduce_sample (expression.realize environment)
836 _ _ (concreteReduction environment)
837 simp only [DomainSafeAt, Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true notValue,
838 Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, concreteReduction] at safe
839 exact safe
840 have domainAE : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
841 Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
842 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) environment, generalArgs) := by
843 filter_upwards [sourceActionSafe] with environment safe
844 exact stochastic_mass_one_imp_domain laws op _ safe.1
845 have extendedSafe : Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws extended :=
846 ⟨historySafe, domainAE⟩
847 refine ⟨extendedSafe, continuationTyped, ?_⟩
848 let transition := (SampleEnv.transitionPack laws op affineArgs generalArgs).kernel
849 have nested : ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
850 ∀ᵐ nextEnvironment ∂transition environment,
851 DomainSafeAt fuel (continuation.realize nextEnvironment) := by
852 filter_upwards [sourceActionSafe] with environment safe
853 rw [SampleEnv.transitionPack_apply]
854 exact (MeasureTheory.ae_map_iff

872theorem determinize_isValue (expression : Expr) :
873 expression.determinize.isValue = expression.isValue := by
874 induction sizeEq : sizeOf expression using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing expression with
875 | h size ih =>
876 cases expression <;> simp only [Expr.determinize, Expr.isValue]
877 case pair left right =>
878 rw [ih (sizeOf left) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf; omega) left rfl,
879 ih (sizeOf right) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf) right rfl]
880 case inl value =>
881 exact ih (sizeOf value) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf) value rfl
882 case inr value =>
883 exact ih (sizeOf value) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf) value rfl
884 case cons head tail =>
885 rw [ih (sizeOf head) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf; omega) head rfl,
886 ih (sizeOf tail) (by rw [← sizeEq]; simp_wf) tail rfl]
887
888noncomputable def targetRealize (environment : Env n) :
889 Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction n → Action
890 | .next expression => .next (expression.realize environment).determinize
891 | .sampleE op affine general continuation =>
892 .sample (.mean, op) (primitiveFiber .mean op
893 (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · environment)) general)
894 (fun value => (continuation.realize (Env.cons value environment)).determinize)
895 | .mean op affine general continuation =>
896 .sample (.mean, op) (primitiveFiber .mean op
897 (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · environment)) general)
898 (fun value => ((continuation (value, 0)).realize environment).determinize)
899 | .sampleG site fiber continuation =>
900 .sample site fiber (fun value => ((continuation value).realize environment).determinize)
901 | .stuck => .stuck
902
903theorem determinize_shift (amount cutoff : Nat) (expression : Expr) :
904 (expression.shift amount cutoff).determinize =
905 expression.determinize.shift amount cutoff := by
906 induction sizeEq : sizeOf expression using Nat.strong_induction_on
907 generalizing expression cutoff with
908 | h size ih =>
909 have recurse (child : Expr) (childCutoff : Nat)
910 (smaller : sizeOf child < sizeOf expression) :
911 (child.shift amount childCutoff).determinize =
912 child.determinize.shift amount childCutoff :=
913 ih (sizeOf child) (sizeEq ▸ smaller) childCutoff child rfl
914 cases expression
915 all_goals
916 simp (disch := simp_wf <;> omega) only [Expr.shift, Expr.mapVars, Expr.determinize, recurse]
917
918set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
919theorem determinize_substAt (depth : Nat) (replacement expression : Expr) :
920 (Expr.substAt depth replacement expression).determinize =
921 Expr.substAt depth replacement.determinize expression.determinize := by
922 induction sizeEq : sizeOf expression using Nat.strong_induction_on
923 generalizing expression depth with
924 | h size ih =>
925 have recurse (child : Expr) (childDepth : Nat)
926 (smaller : sizeOf child < sizeOf expression) :
927 (Expr.substAt childDepth replacement child).determinize =
928 Expr.substAt childDepth replacement.determinize child.determinize :=
929 ih (sizeOf child) (by rwa [← sizeEq]) childDepth child rfl
930 cases expression with
931 | bvar index =>
932 simp only [Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.determinize]
933 split <;> simp_all only [Expr.determinize, determinize_shift]
934 | _ =>
935 simp (disch := simp_wf <;> omega) only
936 [Expr.substAt, Expr.mapVars, Expr.determinize, recurse]
937
938theorem determinize_substHead (body replacement : Expr) :
939 (body.substHead replacement).determinize =
940 body.determinize.substHead replacement.determinize :=
941 determinize_substAt 0 replacement body
942
943theorem determinize_substTwo (body argument function : Expr) :
944 (body.substTwo argument function).determinize =
945 body.determinize.substTwo argument.determinize function.determinize := by
946 simp only [Expr.substTwo, determinize_substAt]

948theorem targetRealize_wrap
949 (action : Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction n)
950 (environment : Env n)
951 (context : Symbolic.AffineExpr n → Symbolic.AffineExpr n)
952 (liftedContext : Symbolic.AffineExpr (n + 1) → Symbolic.AffineExpr (n + 1))
953 (context_realize : ∀ expression,
954 ((context expression).realize environment).determinize =
955 ExprContext ((expression.realize environment).determinize))
956 (lifted_realize : ∀ expression value,
957 ((liftedContext expression).realize (Env.cons value environment)).determinize =
958 ExprContext ((expression.realize (Env.cons value environment)).determinize)) :
959 targetRealize environment (action.wrap context liftedContext) =
960 (targetRealize environment action).wrap ExprContext := by
961 cases action with
962 | next expression => simp [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wrap,
963 targetRealize, Action.wrap, context_realize]
964 | stuck => rfl
965 | sampleE op affine general continuation =>
966 simp only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wrap, targetRealize,
967 Action.wrap, Action.sample.injEq, true_and]
968 funext value
969 exact lifted_realize continuation value
970 | mean op affine general continuation =>
971 simp only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wrap, targetRealize,
972 Action.wrap, Action.sample.injEq, true_and, Function.comp_apply]
973 funext value
974 exact context_realize (continuation (value, 0))
975 | sampleG site fiber continuation =>
976 simp only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wrap, targetRealize,
977 Action.wrap, Action.sample.injEq, true_and, Function.comp_apply]
978 funext value
979 exact context_realize (continuation value)

1846/-- A valid mean call takes one deterministic step, using no additional sample coordinate. -/
1847theorem safeConfigAt_not_stuck
1848 (safe : SafeConfigAt laws (fuel + 1) history expression)
1849 (notValue : expression.isValue ≠ true) : symbolicReduce expression ≠ .stuck := by
1850 intro stuck
1851 let : IsProbabilityMeasure (history.actualMeasure laws) :=
1852 ⟨SampleEnv.actualMeasure_univ_eq_one laws history safe.1⟩
1853 have impossible : ∀ᵐ environment ∂history.actualMeasure laws, False := by
1854 filter_upwards [safe.2.2] with environment valid
1855 have reduction : reduce (expression.realize environment) = .stuck := by
1856 rw [← symbolicReduce_realize safe.2.1 environment, stuck]
1857 rfl
1858 simp [DomainSafeAt, AffineExpr.realize_isValue, notValue, reduction] at valid
1859 rcases impossible.exists with ⟨_, contradiction⟩
1860 exact contradiction

1862theorem source_mean_safe_step
1863 (expression : AffineExpr n) (typed : WellTyped [] expression ty)
1864 (actionEq : symbolicReduce expression = .mean op affine general continuation)
1865 (environment : Env n)
1866 (safe : DomainSafeAt (fuel + 1) (expression.realize environment)) :
1867 domain op (meanParams op affine general environment) ∧
1868 DomainSafeAt fuel ((continuation (meanAffine op affine general)).realize environment) := by
1869 have actionTyped := symbolicReduce_wellTyped typed
1870 rw [actionEq] at actionTyped
1871 obtain ⟨ha, hg, nextTyped, natural⟩ := SymbolicAction.wellTyped_mean_iff.mp actionTyped
1872 have reduction : reduce (expression.realize environment) =
1873 .sample (.mean, op)
1874 (primitiveFiber .mean op (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · environment)) general)
1875 (fun value => (continuation (value, 0)).realize environment) := by
1876 rw [← symbolicReduce_realize typed environment, actionEq]
1877 rfl
1878 have nv := not_value_of_reduce_sample _ _ _ reduction
1879 rw [DomainSafeAt, if_neg nv, reduction] at safe
1880 dsimp only at safe
1881 have valid := (primitiveFiber_mean_mass op affine general ha hg environment).mp safe.1
1882 refine ⟨valid, ?_⟩
1883 rw [primitiveFiber_mean_formula op affine general ha hg environment, if_pos valid,
1884 ae_dirac_eq] at safe
1885 rw [natural]
1886 exact safe.2

1889theorem safeConfigAt_target
1890 (stepKernel : StepKernel) (fuel : Nat)
1891 (history : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws n) (expression : AffineExpr n)
1892 (safe : SafeConfigAt laws fuel history expression) :
1893 DomainSafeAt fuel
1894 ((expression.realize (Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment laws history)).determinize) := by
1895 induction fuel generalizing n history expression with
1896 | zero => trivial
1897 | succ fuel ih =>
1898 rcases safe with ⟨historySafe, typed, sourceSafe⟩
1899 let mean := Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment laws history
1900 by_cases value : expression.isValue = true
1901 · simp only [DomainSafeAt, determinize_isValue,
1902 Symbolic.AffineExpr.realize_isValue, value, ↓reduceIte]
1903 · have targetNotValue :
1904 (expression.realize mean).determinize.isValue ≠ true := by
1905 simpa only [determinize_isValue, Symbolic.AffineExpr.realize_isValue] using value
1906 rw [DomainSafeAt, if_neg targetNotValue]
1907 have targetStep := symbolicReduce_targetRealize typed mean
1908 rw [← targetStep]
1909 have actionTyped := Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_wellTyped typed
1910 generalize actionEq : symbolicReduce expression = action at actionTyped ⊢
1911 cases action with
1912 | next next =>
1913 have nextTyped : WellTyped [] next (.float .E) := by
1914 simpa only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wellTyped_next_iff]
1915 using actionTyped
1916 have nextSafe : ∀ᵐ environment
1917 ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws history,
1918 DomainSafeAt fuel (next.realize environment) := by
1919 filter_upwards [sourceSafe] with environment environmentSafe
1920 have concreteStep : reduce (expression.realize environment) =
1921 .next (next.realize environment) := by
1922 rw [← Symbolic.AffineExpr.symbolicReduce_realize typed
1923 environment, actionEq]
1924 rfl
1925 have sourceNotValue : (expression.realize environment).isValue ≠ true := by
1926 simpa only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.realize_isValue] using value
1927 simpa only [DomainSafeAt,
1928 Bool.eq_false_of_not_eq_true sourceNotValue, Bool.false_eq_true,
1929 ↓reduceIte, concreteStep] using environmentSafe
1930 exact ih history next ⟨historySafe, nextTyped, nextSafe⟩
1931 | mean op affine general continuation =>
1932 obtain ⟨ha, hg, nextTyped, natural⟩ := SymbolicAction.wellTyped_mean_iff.mp actionTyped
1933 have stepSafe := sourceSafe.mono (fun env safe =>
1934 source_mean_safe_step expression typed actionEq env safe)
1935 have valid := SampleEnv.domain_at_meanEnvironment laws history historySafe op
1936 (fun i => affine.getD i.1 0) (fun i => general.getD i.1 0)
1937 (stepSafe.mono fun _ h => h.1)
1938 change domain op (meanParams op affine general mean) at valid
1939 have nextSafe := ih history (continuation (meanAffine op affine general))
1940 ⟨historySafe, nextTyped, stepSafe.mono fun _ h => h.2⟩
1941 simp only [targetRealize]
1942 rw [primitiveFiber_mean_formula op affine general ha hg mean, if_pos valid]
1943 refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
1944 rw [ae_dirac_eq, Filter.eventually_pure, ← natural]
1945 exact nextSafe
1946 | sampleE op affine general continuation =>
1947 let affineArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op) → Symbolic.Affine n :=
1948 fun index => affine.getD index.1 (0, fun _ => 0)
1949 let generalArgs : Fin (Determinize.Spec.Paper.generalArity op) → ℝ :=
1950 fun index => general.getD index.1 0
1951 let extended := Symbolic.SampleEnv.snoc history op affineArgs generalArgs
1952 have extendedSafe := source_sampleE_safe_extension stepKernel fuel history
1953 historySafe expression typed sourceSafe op affine general continuation actionEq
1954 change Symbolic.SampleEnv.DomainSafe laws extended ∧
1955 WellTyped [] continuation (.float .E) ∧
1956 ∀ᵐ environment ∂Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure laws extended,
1957 DomainSafeAt fuel (continuation.realize environment) at extendedSafe
1958 rcases extendedSafe with ⟨extendedDomainSafe, continuationTyped,
1959 continuationSourceSafe⟩
1960 have actionShape :=
1961 Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wellTyped_sampleE_iff.mp actionTyped
1962 rcases actionShape with ⟨affineLength, generalLength, _⟩
1963 have meanDomain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op
1964 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) mean, generalArgs) :=
1965 SampleEnv.domain_at_meanEnvironment laws history historySafe op affineArgs
1966 generalArgs extendedDomainSafe.2
1967 have continuationTargetSafe := ih extended continuation
1968 ⟨extendedDomainSafe, continuationTyped, continuationSourceSafe⟩
1969 classical
1970 simp only [targetRealize]
1971 let params : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Params op :=
1972 (fun index => (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · mean))[index.1]'(by
1973 simp [affineLength]),
1974 fun index => general[index.1]'(by simp [generalLength]))
1975 have paramsEq : params =
1976 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) mean, generalArgs) := by
1977 apply Prod.ext <;> funext index
1978 · simp [params, affineArgs, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, affineLength]
1979 · simp [params, generalArgs, List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, generalLength]
1980 have paramsDomain : Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op params := by
1981 simpa only [paramsEq] using meanDomain
1982 have fiberEq : primitiveFiber .mean op
1983 (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · mean)) general =
1984 Measure.dirac (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op params) := by
1985 have affineMappedLength :
1986 (affine.map (Symbolic.Affine.eval · mean)).length =
1987 Determinize.Spec.Paper.affineArity op := by simpa using affineLength
1988 unfold primitiveFiber
1989 Determinize.Spec.Paper.parseParams
1990 simp only
1991 rw [dif_pos affineMappedLength, dif_pos generalLength]
1992 simp only
1993 change (if Determinize.Spec.Paper.domain op params then
1994 Measure.dirac (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op params) else 0) = _
1995 rw [if_pos paramsDomain]
1996 rw [fiberEq]
1997 constructor
1998 · simp
1999 · rw [ae_dirac_eq]
2000 change DomainSafeAt fuel
2001 ((continuation.realize
2002 (Env.cons (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op params) mean)).determinize)
2003 have meanExtended : Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment laws extended =
2004 Env.cons (Determinize.Spec.Paper.meanValue op
2005 (fun index => Symbolic.Affine.eval (affineArgs index) mean,
2006 generalArgs)) mean := by
2007 rfl
2008 rw [meanExtended] at continuationTargetSafe
2009 simpa only [paramsEq] using continuationTargetSafe
2010 | sampleG site fiber continuation =>
2011 have continuationTyped : ∀ value,
2012 WellTyped [] (continuation value) (.float .E) := by
2013 simpa only [Symbolic.AffineExpr.SymbolicAction.wellTyped_sampleG_iff]
2014 using actionTyped
2015 rcases source_sampleG_safe_swap stepKernel fuel history historySafe expression
2016 typed sourceSafe fiber continuation actionEq with ⟨fiberMass, continuationSafe⟩
2017 unfold targetRealize
2018 refine ⟨fiberMass, ?_⟩
2019 filter_upwards [continuationSafe] with sampledValue sampledSafe
2020 exact ih history (continuation sampledValue)
2021 ⟨historySafe, continuationTyped sampledValue, sampledSafe⟩
2022 | stuck => exact (safeConfigAt_not_stuck ⟨historySafe, typed, sourceSafe⟩ value actionEq).elim

2024theorem determinize_domainSafe_of_typed_source
2025 (laws : Determinize.Proof.Paper.PrimitiveLaws) (stepKernel : StepKernel)
2026 (program : Expr) (typed : Determinize.Spec.Paper.Typed [] program (.float .E))
2027 (sourceSafe : DomainSafe program) :
2028 DomainSafe program.determinize := by
2029 let symbolic := AffineExpr.ofExpr program
2030 have symbolicTyped : WellTyped [] symbolic (.float .E) :=
2031 AffineExpr.wellTyped_ofExpr_of_typed typed
2032 intro fuel
2033 have symbolicSafe : SafeConfigAt laws fuel (.nil : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws 0) symbolic := by
2034 refine ⟨trivial, symbolicTyped, ?_⟩
2035 rw [Symbolic.SampleEnv.actualMeasure, ae_dirac_eq]
2036 simpa only [Filter.eventually_pure, symbolic, AffineExpr.realize_ofExpr]
2037 using sourceSafe fuel
2038 have targetSafe := safeConfigAt_target stepKernel fuel
2039 (.nil : Symbolic.SampleEnv laws 0) symbolic symbolicSafe
2040 simpa only [Symbolic.SampleEnv.meanEnvironment, symbolic, AffineExpr.realize_ofExpr]
2041 using targetSafe

2043theorem bind_bind_const_swap {alpha beta gamma : Type*}
2044 [MeasurableSpace alpha] [MeasurableSpace beta] [MeasurableSpace gamma]
2045 (left : Measure alpha) (right : Measure beta) [SFinite left] [SFinite right]
2046 (kernel : Kernel (alpha × beta) gamma) [IsSFiniteKernel kernel] :
2047 left.bind (fun a => right.bind fun b => kernel (a, b)) =
2048 right.bind (fun b => left.bind fun a => kernel (a, b)) := by
2049 have leftFamilyMeasurable : Measurable
2050 (fun a => right.bind fun b => kernel (a, b)) := by
2051 apply Measure.measurable_of_measurable_coe
2052 intro set measurableSet
2053 have jointMeasurable := kernel.measurable_coe measurableSet
2054 change Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun a b => kernel (a, b) set)) at jointMeasurable
2055 convert jointMeasurable.lintegral_prod_right (ν := right) using 1
2056 funext a
2057 exact Measure.bind_apply measurableSet
2058 ((kernel.measurable.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)).aemeasurable)
2059 have rightFamilyMeasurable : Measurable
2060 (fun b => left.bind fun a => kernel (a, b)) := by
2061 apply Measure.measurable_of_measurable_coe
2062 intro set measurableSet
2063 have jointMeasurable := kernel.measurable_coe measurableSet
2064 change Measurable (Function.uncurry (fun a b => kernel (a, b) set)) at jointMeasurable
2065 convert jointMeasurable.lintegral_prod_left (μ := left) using 1
2066 funext b
2067 exact Measure.bind_apply measurableSet
2068 ((kernel.measurable.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aemeasurable)
2069 ext set measurableSet
2070 rw [Measure.bind_apply measurableSet leftFamilyMeasurable.aemeasurable,
